Name: A1_Welcome
Subject: Welcome back, {EMP}!
Body:
Good morning, {EMP}!

We hope you slept well. Today is a big day, and we're so glad you're here for it.

Your task list is on your badge. Please complete Mandatory Compliance Training before noon.

Remember: you are exactly where you need to be.

Warmly,
The People Team

Name: A1_ChairmanMemo
Subject: Places, everyone.
Body:
Team,

Big day. Everyone knows their marks.

Let's keep it natural. Let's keep it moving. And let's get it in one take this time.

- C

Name: A1_ITNotice
Subject: Scheduled maintenance: Corridor B
Body:
Hello,

Corridor B will undergo routine continuity maintenance today. You may notice flickering lights, repeated signage, or a brief sense that you have walked this way before. This is expected.

Please do not report it.

IT Service Desk

{GLYPHS_A}

Name: A1_Coffee
Subject: Fresh coffee is ready ☕
Body:
A fresh pot has been brewed for you, {EMP}.
It is exactly the temperature you like.
It has always been exactly the temperature you like.

Name: A2_Lunch
Subject: Lunch is served
Body:
Lunch is served.

Lunch is served.

Please enjoy your lunch. Lunch is served.

Name: A2_CallInvite
Subject: Invite: Sync (12:30)
Body:
Sync @ 12:30, Conference Room
Organizer: C
Camera: optional (organizer's camera will be off)

Agenda:
1. Welcome
2. Quarterly energy targets
3. Morale
4. Retake

Name: A1_SecurityIncident
Subject: INCIDENT REPORT #4471-B
Body:
Employee {EMP},

At approximately now, you threw an object at a member of Security.
Incidents logged today: {HITS}.
This has been noted. It has been noted before.
Security does not forget. Security does not need to.

Further incidents will be escalated to HR.

- Officer on duty (the one you hit)

Name: A1_HRIncident
Subject: A gentle reminder about workplace conduct :)
Body:
Hi {EMP}!

We've received {HITS} reports of office supplies travelling at speed.
At HALCYON, every object has its place, and so does every employee.

Please complete Respectful Workplace Module 2 at your earliest convenience (your terminal, Training tab).
It takes about a minute. It has always taken about a minute.

Warmly,
People Team

Name: A1_HRIncident2
Subject: Following up :)
Body:
Hi again {EMP}!

The reports are still coming in. So are the staplers.

Respectful Workplace Module 3 has been assigned to you. There is no Module 4.

Warmly (less),
People Team

Name: A1_HRHotBeverage
Subject: Hot beverage safety :)
Body:
Hi {EMP}!

A coworker has reported a hot beverage incident. HALCYON mugs are designed to be carried, sipped and set down, in that order.

You have been enrolled in Hot Beverage Safety (it's a lid).

Each incident counts as two incidents. We didn't make the rules. Well. We did.

Warmly,
People Team

Name: A1_HRCertificate
Subject: Certificate of Completion
Body:
Congratulations, {EMP}!

You have completed RESPECTFUL WORKPLACE.
This certificate is valid for the rest of the day.

Your coworkers have been notified and feel safer already.

Name: A1_CaffeineNoReply
Subject: About your caffeine intake
Body:
Hi {EMP}!

Our sensors noticed you've had five coffees today. That's wonderful!
Energy is our greatest asset, and yours is looking great.

Please don't stop.

- Wellness

Name: A1_MoraleToss
Subject: Three in a row!
Body:
{EMP},

Three baskets in a row! The Morale Team noticed. The Morale Team notices everything.

You have been entered into the Employee of the Take draw. You are the only entry. You have always been the only entry.

Name: A1_KeyLock2NoReply
Subject: New sign-in: Supply Closet
Body:
A new sign-in was detected on the Supply Closet terminal.

User: 4470
Badge: 4471

If this was you, no action is needed. It was you.

Name: A1_MailboxMigration
Subject: Mailbox migration complete
Body:
Hi {EMP},

Your mailbox migration is complete. Mail addressed to 4470 will now be delivered to you.
Please do not reply to 4470's correspondence. 4470 is no longer with the production.

- IT

Name: A2_Wellness
Subject: Quick wellness check-in :)
Body:
Hi {EMP}!

It's lunchtime, and we care about how you're feeling.

How are you today? Just hit reply.

(This check-in is anonymous. It is addressed to you by name.)

Name: A2_WellnessFollowUp
Subject: Re: Quick wellness check-in :)
Body:
{EMP},

Thank you for telling us something is wrong. Nothing is wrong.

We've booked you into the Wellness Center (end of Corridor B). Rest. Recharge. Return.

Are you feeling better now?

Name: A2_ITSecurityNoReply
Subject: You replied to a phishing email
Body:
{EMP},

You sent your key signature to "Payro11 Department". Please note the two ones.

This is your one warning. (It isn't your one warning. You've had this warning before.)

- IT Security

Name: A2_ITThanksNoReply
Subject: Thanks for reporting!
Body:
{EMP},

Thank you for reporting that phishing email. Good catch!

Most people send their key. Most people are still here.

- IT Security

Subject: ACTION REQUIRED: verify your key

Name: A2_ChairmanMemo
Subject: Notes from this morning
Body:
{EMP},

Good energy this morning. A little hesitant at the corridor. We'll go again.

Don't look at the camera.

- C

Name: A3_TeamBuilding
Subject: Mandatory team building: Wellness Center
Body:
Overtime is a privilege!

Join us in the Wellness Center for a short trust exercise. Your team will be there to catch you.

Attendance is mandatory. Attendance has always been mandatory.

Name: A3_ChairmanMemo
Subject: That's nearly a wrap
Body:
{EMP},

You've been wonderful. One more scene.

The button you've been looking at will light up soon.

- C

Body:

The man from upstairs says they're right where they need to be. He says 2:14 is 'the golden hour'.

We asked golden for what. He laughed and told us to strike the coffee cart.
